class.name: NNDistanceToNode3DSearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Filters and scores [Node3D] candidates by distance to a target [Node3D].
class.description: Measures each [Node3D] candidate's distance to [member distance_to] across [member min_distance]..[member max_distance] (using squared distance for speed). Use to find targets near, far from, or within a specific range of a moving 3D node (combine with an inverted [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.activation_curve] to prefer closer candidates). For a fixed coordinate instead of a node, use [NNDistanceToVector3SearchCriterion].

members.member: Target [Node3D] to measure distance to. When unset, candidates pass unfiltered with score [code]1.0[/code].
Maximum distance. Maps to [code]1.0[/code] when scoring; farther candidates are filtered out when filtering is enabled. Must be greater than [member min_distance].
Minimum distance. Maps to [code]0.0[/code] when scoring; closer candidates are filtered out when filtering is enabled. Must be non-negative and less than [member max_distance].
